basic_info.description: Sunny Portola single family home with fabulous outdoor space and sweeping view! This 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence has been beautifully updated with sleek finishes and hardwood flooring and is ready to move in! On the main level is an inviting formal living room with a fireplace, dining area, and an open kitchen equipped with quartz countertops and stainless-steel appliances. Off the kitchen is access to the expansive back deck/patio, with space for outdoor dining, entertaining, and a sweeping view from Twin Peaks and Sutro Tower to the waters of the Bay! These generous, light-filled bedrooms share a classic black-and-white tile bathroom with shower over a tub.   Downstairs is a sprawling family room, which could be used as a bedroom, with access to the garden and an attractive bath with shower around the corner. The garden offers a paved area for seating and a large lawn for recreation. A 1-car garage includes laundry and a large storage area, perfect for a gym, workshop or storage. The location is wonderfully convenient to transit (44-O'Shaugnessy, 14X-Mission, I-280/101, & Glen Park Bart) and walking distance from McLaren Park, boasting 313 acres of playgrounds, picnic areas, a dog park, sports courts and a pool, an amphitheater, trails, a golf course, and more.
